A_mobile_contact_regression.description: Contact-form submission regression on mobile web in Riyadh from the web-2026.07.2 release.
A_mobile_contact_regression.mechanism: contact_started -> contact_submitted probability multiplied by 0.55; 45% of lost submits emit a failed event.

B_channel_mix_shift.description: Paid-social volume surges after the change date. Paid social converts poorly, so aggregate listing-to-contact falls although within-channel rates are stable.
B_channel_mix_shift.mechanism: paid_social traffic weight multiplied by 3.4 (5-day ramp).

C_app_selection_effect.description: App sessions look far better at listing-to-contact, mostly because app users are overwhelmingly returning visitors (who convert ~1.75x better).
C_app_selection_effect.mechanism: device multiplier for app is only 1.04 vs desktop 1.0; returning multiplier 1.75.

D_jeddah_app_tracking.description: Staged app-5.12.0 rollout in Jeddah double-fires contact_submitted (without a lead_id) on contact start and on some listing renders. Raw contact counts jump; real leads do not.
D_jeddah_app_tracking.mechanism: ghost contact_submitted events with null lead_id; some without a preceding contact_started.

E_dubai_luxury_behaviour.description: Dubai luxury-band users start ~38% fewer contacts while saving more, across all devices and channels — a genuine behavioural change, not a regression.

EXP_014.description: Historical randomized experiment: sticky contact CTA in Dubai and Abu Dhabi.
